header: Song-part file signature table, 9 x 8-byte records {u32 signature string; u16 offset in file; u16 compare length} indexed by part (LSW, PMT, SQT, CMP, TM, MSP, RCM, MD, TLX); this label is record 0 = the string-pointer column. Basis: HDAE5000_CheckFileSignature reads (base + part*8) and passes it to HDAE5000_StrNCmp.
evidence: hdae5000_ui_display.s:11265 `extz xwa / sll xwa, 0x03` -- index = part (WA) * 8, the record stride

hdae5000_ui_display.s:11267 `ld xbc, HDAE5000_CheckFileSignature_Data` then 11269-11271 `ld xwa,(xbc) / push xwa / call HDAE5000_StrNCmp` -- the long at +0 is the signature string, first StrNCmp argument

hdae5000_ui_display.s:11380 `ld wa, 0:i3 / calr HDAE5000_CheckFileSignature` -- caller HDAE5000_FdSong_CheckFiles passes the part index (0 = .LSW, 1 = .PMT, ...) after reading 512 bytes of <name><ext>
hdae5000_data_tables.s:16152 `.byte 0x98, 0x8e` + `.asciz "/"` -- record 0's pointer 0x002F8E98 spelled as bytes (ROM 0x2F8E20: 98 8e 2f 00 04 00 02 00 = ptr 0x2F8E98 "HK", offset 4, length 2)

ROM 0x2F8E20..0x2F8E67: 9 records -> "HK"@4/2 (LSW), "HK"@0/2 (PMT), 01 08@5/2 (SQT), "H\0K"@0/3 (CMP), "KN5000 SOUND RAM"@0/16 (TM), "H\0K"@0/3 (MSP), "H\0K"@0/3 (RCM), "HK"@0/2 (MD), "TLhd"@0/4 (TLX); note the routine header's 'HK\0 (CMP)' should read 'H\0K'
Follow-up: the pointers are spelled .byte/.asciz "/" -- could become `.long <sig string label>`, .short offset, .short length rows (the signature strings at 0x2F8E68-0x2F8E9B have no labels yet)

header: HDAE5000_PartSignatureTable + 4: the u16 column giving where in the part file's first 512 bytes the signature sits. Basis: HDAE5000_CheckFileSignature adds (this + part*8) to the buffer pointer before HDAE5000_StrNCmp.
evidence: hdae5000_ui_display.s:11259 `lda xhl, (HDAE5000_CheckFileSignature_Data_2:24)` + 11260-11264 `add xhl,xde / ld de,(xhl) / extz xde / add xde,xbc / push xde` -- u16 at +4 of record [part] is added to the file buffer (XBC) to form the second StrNCmp argument
hdae5000_data_tables.s:16155 `.byte 0x04` / 16156 `.byte 0x00` -- record 0 (LSW) offset = 4; ROM 0x2F8E24 = 0x2F8E20 + 4
ROM offsets per part: 4, 0, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0

header: HDAE5000_PartSignatureTable + 6: the u16 column giving how many signature bytes to compare. Basis: HDAE5000_CheckFileSignature pushes (this + part*8) as the HDAE5000_StrNCmp count.
evidence: hdae5000_ui_display.s:11252 `lda xhl, (HDAE5000_CheckFileSignature_Data_3:24)` + 11253-11255 `add xhl,xde / ld de,(xhl) / pushw de` -- u16 at +6 of record [part] is pushed first = StrNCmp's length argument
hdae5000_data_tables.s:16158 `.byte 0x02` / 16159 `.byte 0x00` -- record 0 ("HK") length 2; ROM 0x2F8E26 = 0x2F8E20 + 6
ROM lengths per part: 2, 2, 2, 3, 16, 3, 3, 2, 4 -- each equals its signature's length ("KN5000 SOUND RAM" = 16, "TLhd" = 4)

header: 8 zero bytes copied over the RCM stream context at RAM 0x238F1C (u16 state, u16 dir, u16 song, u16 last result) before each RCM load/save. Basis: `ldirw` (95 11 = LDIRW (XIX+),(XIY+)) in HDAE5000_LoadSong_Rcm/SaveSong_Rcm copies XIY = this ROM block to XIX = 0x238F1C; the source comments 'destination'/'source' are swapped.
evidence: hdae5000_ui_display.s:10014-10017 `ld xiy, HDAE5000_LoadSong_Rcm_Data / ld xix, HDAE5000_RAM_HdStreamBufferEnd / ld bc, 4:i3 / mriw2 0x95, 0x11` -- 4-word block copy; prefix 0x95 = word, reg code 5 = (XIX+) <- (XIY+) (MAME 900tbl.hxx op_80/op_LDIRW: p1 = reg(op-1) = XIX is written, p2 = reg(op) = XIY is read), so this ROM label is the SOURCE and RAM 0x238F1C the destination (the inline comments say the opposite; `ldirw (xix+), (xiy+)` would also replace the raw mriw2 pseudo)
hdae5000_ui_display.s:11034-11037 -- same 8-byte copy at the start of HDAE5000_SaveSong_Rcm
hdae5000_ui_display.s:10019 `ld (0x238f1e:24), wa` / 10021 `ld (0x238f20:24), wa` -- directory and song then overwrite context words +2/+4

hdae5000_ui_display.s:14453 `ld bc, (HDAE5000_RAM_HdStreamBufferEnd:24)` / 14479 `ldw (...), 1` -- HDAE5000_RcmStream_Read uses word +0 as its state (0 = first call, 1 = continuing); RcmStream_Write uses 2; 14595 `ld hl, (0x238F22:24)` RcmStream_LastResult reads word +6
hdae5000_data_tables.s:16143-16144 `HDAE5000_LoadSong_Rcm_Data: .zero 8` -- the template is all zero: state idle, dir/song/result 0

header: Boot-splash palette: 256 RGBX entries loaded by HDAE5000_Boot_Init right before it blits HDAE5000_Bitmap_BootSplash. Basis: Boot_Init's lda + HDAE5000_Load_Palette, and the bitmap renders correctly only with it.
evidence: hdae5000_ui_display.s:7267-7268 `lda xwa, (HDAE5000_Palette_Data:24) / calr HDAE5000_Load_Palette` -- sole code reader, in HDAE5000_Boot_Init, immediately followed by the splash blit (7270-7280: EVT_GET_BITMAP_DATA -> 0x2E61CE, copied to VRAM 0x1A0000)
hdae5000_data_tables.s:16109-16122 `HDAE5000_Palette_Data:` -- 0x400 B built from images/HDAE5000_Palette_Splash.txt; directly followed by HDAE5000_Bitmap_BootSplash (16124)
hdae5000_data_tables.s:16128 `Rendered with HDAE5000_Palette_Data (0x2E5DCE) it is unambiguous.` -- the palette that makes the splash render
Siblings are named by image: HDAE5000_Palette_TitleLogo/_DriveMech/_FilePanel/_HddIcon (hdae5000_data_tables.s:12324-12375)

Rename also: the 'name is kept as-is' note at 16111-16115, comments at ui_display.s:7186/7234, hd-ae5000_v2_06i.s:225, data_tables.s:12239/16128, scripts/build/convert_images.py:171, scripts/tools/split_hdae5000_binaries.py:89, symbols/hdae5000_symbols_reference.txt (archive/asl is not authoritative)

header: Empty routine (a lone ret) that HDAE5000_NameHistory_Push calls last, with XWA = the history it just updated; its only caller. Basis: the single calr in NameHistory_Push (ROM search finds no other reference to 0x28B33D).
evidence: hdae5000_ui_display.s:698-699 `ld xwa, xiz / calr HDAE5000_Return_Stub` -- called at the end of HDAE5000_NameHistory_Push with XWA = the history
hdae5000_ui_display.s:663-664 `HDAE5000_Return_Stub: ret` -- the whole body
ROM scan of hd-ae5000_v2_06i.ic4: no 24-bit literal 0x28B33D and exactly one calr to it (at 0x28B376, the line above) -- no table or other caller
Name reflects only what is proven (empty, called after a push); what the original function did before being compiled out is unknown

header: "050354": the six-digit code that, typed on the ATTEN_HD_FORMAT dialog, makes HDAE5000_FormatDialog_CodeDigit return 2, on which HDAE5000_AttenHDFormatSwCatch shows WAIT_HD_FORMAT and formats the hard disk. Basis: StrPrefixCmp in CodeDigit + the result-2 branch.
basis: reader + caller's use of the result
evidence: hdae5000_hd_driver.s:5315-5323 `pushw HDAE5000_Str_050354@hi16/@lo16 / lda xwa,(0x22ad9e:24) / push xwa / call HDAE5000_StrPrefixCmp / ... / ld iz, 2:i3` -- after six digits, a match returns 2
hdae5000_hd_driver.s:5547 `ld xwa, HDAE5000_OBJ_WAIT_HD_FORMAT` + 5553 `call HDAE5000_HD_FormatDrive` -- result 2 in HDAE5000_AttenHDFormatSwCatch formats the drive
